1.explanation: ReplaceOptions.js is where all replace-target definitions live (e.g. the arrays of possible replacement BPMN element types). It needs to include entries for DataObjectReference ↔ DataStoreReference. ReplaceMenuProvider is responsible for reading those options and building the actual popup-menu UI. Its getEntries and helper methods (_getDataObjectIsCollection and _createEntries) must be adapted to include the missing DataStoreReference option when the current element is a DataObjectReference (and vice-versa). Without changes here, the replace submenu remains empty except for the collection marker.
1.bug_scenario: When right-clicking (or invoking the popup menu on) a DataObjectReference in the diagram, the “replace” submenu only shows the collection marker entry (the three-bar icon) – it’s otherwise empty. The user cannot switch a DataObjectReference into a DataStoreReference (and vice-versa), so the menu feels empty and out of place.

2.explanation:
The two core places to change are:  

1. lib/features/replace/ReplaceOptions.js  
   • This file contains the static replacement‐options arrays (e.g. the DATA_OBJECT_REFERENCE array only contains the collection toggle today). We need to augment the DATA_OBJECT_REFERENCE array to include an entry for DataStoreReference, and likewise extend DATA_STORE_REFERENCE to include DataObjectReference.  

2. lib/features/popup-menu/ReplaceMenuProvider.js (class ReplaceMenuProvider)  
   • getEntries(...) drives which replacement menus get shown per element type. It currently invokes _getDataObjectIsCollection to only present the collection toggle for DataObjectReference. We must update getEntries (and _getDataObjectIsCollection) so that, when the businessObject is a DataObjectReference, it not only offers the collection option but also the DataStoreReference option, and symmetrically allow DataStoreReference to switch to DataObjectReference.
2.bug_scenario: When right-clicking on a DataObjectReference in the diagram, the replace menu only ever shows the “collection” toggle (i.e. switch to a DataObjectCollection) and nothing else. The menu feels empty, because there is no option to switch a DataObjectReference into a DataStoreReference. Likewise, if you have a DataStoreReference selected, you cannot switch back to a DataObjectReference. The feature request is to add DataStoreReference to the DataObjectReference replace menu (and vice-versa) so that the replace-menu remains populated and useful.
